(4) New GET /listing/brands?vertical=&q= (public brand search). VALIDATED local: store_code QATE→SKU QATE-0001→sub-SKU QATE-0001-BLU-32, brand capture+search, rolled back. Additive — existing wizard calls keep working (SKU now auto-filled as a bonus). DEFERRED to Ship 2.2: wizard UI for brand field + SKU chip + per-colour variant-pics card + section-progress; registration schema (gender multi-select, delivery, remove cities/fee, return-window override) + admin global return-window.
